results.title: Millsap Head Football Coach Jacob Johnson passes away at 45
results.description: Millsap Head Football Coach Jacob Johnson's 3-year battle with cancer ended Friday as Jacob's wife, Cassie, announced his passing on Facebook. The devastating loss comes a month after the family announced the return of Jacob's leukemia after entering remission earlier this year. results.title: Canadiens much further along in their rebuild than Blackhawks are in theirs
results.description: “Montreal was very young last year, and once it clicked, it clicked,” Hawks coach Jeff Blashill said. “And there’s zero doubt in my mind that once it clicks here, it’s going to really click.”
